title: Report a bug from the upper right, and crashes report themselves
items: A small bug key sits left of the compass row. It takes a picture of the town and asks what went wrong, then sends that with the year, where you stand and your device.
Settings › Show › On screen turns the key off.
If the page is cut off, for example a phone running out of memory or the display resetting, the next visit sends a report of it.
The first-time tour points out the key.
